# GitArt

> Free browser tool that draws names, words and pixel art on a GitHub contribution graph by generating git commit commands. No login, no token, nothing leaves the browser.

How it works: pick a year, type a word or click squares on the calendar, generate the commands, run them inside a new repository and push. The commits are ordinary empty commits with backdated timestamps, so GitHub counts them like any other commit.

## Pages

- [GitArt](https://gitart.pages.dev/): design the graph and generate the commands
- [Examples](https://gitart.pages.dev/examples): finished contribution graphs
- [Source code](https://github.com/sameemul-haque/GitArt): open source under GPL-3.0
